data.long_meaning: In Persian culture, 'Keyan' means light and 'Dokht' means daughter. Thus, Keyandokht translates to 'Princess of Light'. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Keyandokht usually hope their child will grow to embody princess of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
